jobs_results.title: Data Analyst (Finance & Validation): Internship → Full-Time
jobs_results.description:
Affluense.ai · Bengaluru (On-site) · Internship with conversion to full-time




About Affluense

Affluense is an AI-powered wealth intelligence platform used by leading wealth managers, banks and BFSI firms across India. We track who’s creating wealth, where money is moving and what’s happening in the market, and we turn that into intelligence our customers act on every day.

Our customers make real decisions based on what we deliver, so every number has to be right.




The Role

You’ll be the analytical gatekeeper of our intelligence. Before anything reaches a customer, you make sure it’s accurate, complete and makes sense. You’ll work closely with the founders and the data team, reviewing financial information, deal activity and wealth signals, and catching what others miss.

This role suits someone who enjoys cross-checking a figure until it adds up, who notices when something looks slightly off, and who follows the markets out of genuine interest.




What you’ll do

Review and verify financial data, company information and deal activity for accuracy and consistencyCross-reference information across multiple sources and resolve any discrepanciesSpot anomalies, gaps and patterns in large datasetsBuild Excel models and Python scripts that automate repetitive checks and make the team fasterTrack funding rounds, exits, M&A, IPOs and other money movements across India’s marketHelp define and improve our data quality standards as we scale


What we’re looking for

Quick and sharp with numbers. You enjoy working with them.Obsessive attention to detail. Small errors bother you.Strong hands-on Excel skills: lookups, pivots, formulas, data cleaningWorking knowledge of Python (pandas is a plus), especially for automating tasksA real interest in finance: startups, funding, markets, wealth creation and how money movesComfortable reading financial statements, deal announcements and business newsFinal-year students or recent graduates in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Engineering, Statistics or a related field


Bonus points

You follow deal news (Entrackr, Inc42, VCCircle, ET) for funCFA Level 1 or NISM certification, or currently pursuing oneYou’ve built a tracker, model or automation on your own initiative


Why join us

Direct exposure to founders and how a fast-growing, funded AI startup operatesA clear path from internship to a full-time role, based on performanceA front-row view of India’s wealth and deal ecosystemReal ownership: your work goes straight to the customers

jobs_results.title: R&D and Data Intern
jobs_results.description:
Company Description Yasya Biosciences is an innovation-driven biotechnology company focused on creating meaningful, science-backed skincare and healing solutions. Founded by two biotechnologists, the company integrates rigorous laboratory research with clinical insights to develop high-impact products.


Yasya
Biosciences is currently advancing a collagen and nanobiotechnology-based wound care line under prototype development. Interns get to join a growing venture where scientific curiosity, product innovation, and real-world impact are closely connected.


Role Description The R&D and Data Intern role is an on-site internship based in Faridabad. The intern will support laboratory experiments, assist in data collection and analysis related to wound care and skincare formulations, and help maintain accurate research records. Daily tasks may include preparing samples, conducting basic tests under supervision, organizing experimental data, and contributing to internal reports and documentation.


The intern will collaborate with scientists and product development team members, participate in team discussions, and help translate research findings into actionable insights for product improvement. This role is designed to provide hands-on experience in biotechnology-focused R&D and exposure to data-driven decision-making within a growing startup environment.


Qualifications
 Strong foundation in Research and Development (R&D) and applied Research in Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Microbiology related fields. Analytical Skills for data interpretation, problem-solving, and drawing clear conclusions from experimental results. Communication skills for documenting findings, preparing summaries, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Laboratory Skills, including safe handling of materials, following protocols, and accurately recording observations. Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Pharmacy, or a related discipline. Familiarity with basic data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets; exposure to statistical methods is an advantage). Attention to detail, ability to follow instructions, and willingness to learn new techniques and workflows. Interest in wound healing, biomaterials, or nanobiotechnology is highly beneficial. 
Stipend- Can be discussed.
